# secopsctl lists

Lists: reference lists (empty) and watchlists

## lists empty

MUTATING (guarded): clear all entries from a reference list

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl lists empty <name> [flags]
```

```text
Clear all entries from one reference list by name or full resource name.
The command resolves the list first and previews only metadata plus entry
count, not entry values. Guarded: dry-run by default, --yes to apply.
Re-pull afterwards so local mirrors live.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |

## lists watchlists add-entity

MUTATING (guarded): put one entity on a watchlist (containment/tracking)

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl lists watchlists add-entity <watchlist-id> (--ip A | --mac M | --hostname H | --user U | --email E) [flags]
```

```text
Add an asset or user to a SIEM watchlist (entities:add). Exactly one
selector is set per the API contract. Guarded: dry-run by default, --yes to
apply.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--email` | string | - | user email address |
| `--hostname` | string | - | asset hostname |
| `--ip` | string | - | asset IP address |
| `--mac` | string | - | asset MAC address |
| `--namespace` | string | - | optional entity namespace |
| `--user` | string | - | user id |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |

## lists watchlists create

MUTATING (guarded): create a watchlist (tracking/hunting list)

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl lists watchlists create --name <id> --display-name <s> [--description s] [--factor f] [flags]
```

```text
Create a watchlist for tracking or hunting — a named set of entities whose
membership can feed the risk-score multiplier. --factor is the risk
multiplier (default 1.0). Guarded: dry-run by default, --yes to apply.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--description` | string | - | optional description |
| `--display-name` | string | - | human-readable display name (required) |
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--factor` | float64 | 1 | risk-score multiplying factor |
| `--name` | string | - | watchlist id/name (required) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |

## lists watchlists delete

MUTATING (guarded): delete a watchlist

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl lists watchlists delete <id> [--force] [flags]
```

```text
Delete a watchlist by id. --force removes it even if it still has members.
Guarded: dry-run by default, --yes to apply.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--force` | bool | false | delete even if the watchlist has members |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |

## lists watchlists get

Get one watchlist by id

```text
secopsctl lists watchlists get <id>
```

## lists watchlists list

List watchlists

```text
secopsctl lists watchlists list [flags]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | int | 100 | max watchlists to fetch/show |

## lists watchlists remove-entity

MUTATING (guarded): take one entity off a watchlist

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl lists watchlists remove-entity <entity-resource-name> [flags]
```

```text
Remove an entity membership from a watchlist by its full entity resource
name (the name a watchlist's membership listing returns) — the inverse of
`add-entity`. Guarded: dry-run by default, --yes to apply.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |
